key.name: panel-content
key.description: Which speeds the panel indicator shows: download and upload, only one of them, or their sum.

key.name: panel-style
key.description: Detailed shows full units, compact uses one-letter units, stacked shows download above upload.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where in the top panel the indicator is placed.

key.name: show-units
key.description: Show the unit next to each speed in the panel.

key.name: use-bits
key.description: Show speeds in bits per second (Mbps) instead of bytes per second (MB/s).

key.name: binary-units
key.description: Use 1024-based units (KiB, MiB, GiB) instead of 1000-based units (KB, MB, GB).

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often, in seconds, network speed is sampled.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Write verbose diagnostic messages to the system journal.
